newsitem.title: HONG KONG: United Airlines jet returns to HK after engine fire.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines jet returns to HK after engine fire.

text.p: A United Airlines Boeing 747 airliner with 357 passengers aboard was returning to Hong Kong on Wednesday after an engine caught fire on takeoff, a civil aviation official said.
A fire service official said the fire had been extinguished, and a civil aviation official said nobody had been hurt. The plave was due to land around 0620 gmt.
Alice Chiu, in the civil aviation public relations department, told Reuters flight UA806 had run into problems with one of its engines.
An official at United Airlines said the jumbo jet was bound for San Francisco, having flown into Hong Kong from Singapore earlier in the day.
Chiu said there were 357 passengers aboard and about 10 crew. Nobody had been injured and the plane was not known to be carrying dangerous cargo. Fire services were standing by.
"The problem is with the Number 1 engine," Chiu said, adding that the cause of the fire was not known.
